Microphone Choice asks which microphone to use when a Bluetooth input connects, helping many headphones retain higher-quality playback.

**Homebrew:**

```sh
brew install Mahad871/tap/microphone-choice
brew services start microphone-choice
```

**Direct download:** Download the universal ZIP below, unzip it, move the app to Applications, and open it once. Requires macOS 13 or newer. This build is ad hoc signed and not Apple notarized, so macOS may require an [Open Anyway](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445) decision. See the [README](https://github.com/Mahad871/microphone-choice#install) for details.
